messages:
Anya: Heads-up — proposed cutover choreography for the regional rollout next week. Trying to nail scope and ops contracts before the shiproom. TL;DR: staged regions (us-west -> eu -> apac), tenant opt-outs, small A/B for quality, and explicit fallback routes. Thoughts?
Sam: Sounds good. Do we have clear telemetry gates for when to stop? e.g., error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increase > 200ms?
Anya: Yes, proposing three gates: 1) infra (error rate), 2) quality (evaluator prompt set pass rate), 3) cost (token burn jump). If any gate trips, we trigger the rollback ladder.
Devin: Can we define the rollback ladder concretely? i.e., automatic downgrade -> traffic pin -> feature-flag kill -> emergency region failover. Need names for flags and order.
Marco: Also need per-tenant soft-hold: some enterprise customers asked for opt-out during initial 48h. How do we surface that in orchestration?
Anya: Plan: on roll, default opt-in; mark enterprise tenants as hold via `tenant-cutover` flag. Ops can flip a `tenant-cutover/hold/<tenant_id>` boolean. We'll provide a UI list and API endpoint for bulk holds.
Sam: For telemetry gating, who owns the evaluator prompt set and scoring? We need a small sentinel set and owner to act in the first 2h if quality slides.
QA-Bot: Test note: will run the sample prompt set (200 prompts) every 5m in shadow mode. Alert threshold set to >3% regression vs baseline.
Devin: Feature flag plan (example):
```json
{"flag":"new-routing-v2","variants":["stable","v2","v2-lite"],"default":"stable"}
```
We should use variant weights not raw percentages for tenant-slices. Also add `auto-evict` policy metadata.
OpsBot: Deploy pipeline queued: canary job created for `new-routing-v2` in us-west with 5% traffic for 30m. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1955
Marco: Fallback policy: if model latency > 1s or token cost > 3x baseline for 10m, route to `compat-model` in same region; if same-region capacity exhausted, route to multi-region fallback with reduced max_tokens. Also add a short-circuit for high-priority customers to always use the dedicated path.
Liz: Cutover window ask: can we schedule during Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC? Prod SRE prefers low-traffic window. Need confirmation from sales for customer blackout windows.
Anya: Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC works for initial warmup. Roll plan: Step 0: preflight (config push, shadow sampling). Step 1: us-west micro-canary (2% -> 10% -> 20%). Step 2: us-west full (60% -> 100%) + start eu shadow. Step 3: eu micro-canary. Step 4: apac micro-canary. Each step gated by telemetry and manual ops approval at the 10% and 60% transitions.
Sam: A/B detail: run an A/B experiment for quality variant where 5% of users see `v2` and 5% see `v2-lite` for 24h; keep a 1% holdback for control. Metric owners: Sam (latency/cost), Anya (quality evaluator owner), Marco (customer impact).
Devin: Ops config snippet for auto-evict rule: 
```yaml
auto_evict:
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  p95_latency_ms: 200
  consecutive_windows: 3
```
This plugs into the router to trigger safe fallback.
Marco: Need explicit SLA clause: during the 48h warm window, if a major outage occurs we commit to priority rollback within 15m and a postmortem owner. Ops/Oncall to list owner mapping in the playbook.
QA-Bot: Test plan: smoke + long-tail fuzzing for 12h pre-roll. Will post results to #eng-runtime and attach failing prompts.
Anya: Quick negotiation: Product can reduce initial scope to `v2-lite` only if SRE prefers minimizing surface area. We still run shadow `v2` for telemetry but not route live users. Decision needed by EOD today.
Liz: Sales ask: push a customer opt-in API so we can onboard a pilot tenant first. Can devex create a small webhook?
Devin: I can add a minimal endpoint `POST /pilot-tenant/{id}/optin` and wire it to the feature flag service. ETA ~6h.
Sam: Ops checklist items: database migrations (flag metadata table), routing config rollout, canary dashboards, alert runbooks. Can we get a checklist repo link?
Anya: I'll create a checklist PR in infra/rollout-checklists and ping #shiproom. Owners: Anya (product lead), Sam (telemetry), Devin (flag infra), Marco (customer ops), Liz (sales coordination).
Marco: Suggest adding an emergency polyfill: if downstream generator fails, return a short canned response with a trace id and escalate. Keeps the UI responsive.
Anya: Agreed — add `polyfill-resp` with short fallback template and link to incident runbook.
Sam: Final ask: who is authorized to hit the kill-switch? Recommend Product + Oncall + CEO escalation only.
Anya: Proposed kill-switch policy: `kill-switch/new-routing-v2` requires two approvers from the set {Sam, Oncall, Anya}. OpsBot will reject single-approver requests.
OpsBot: Noted. Approval policy created.
Anya: OK, next steps: 1) confirm scope (v2-lite only?) by EOD, 2) Devin to open pilot endpoint PR, 3) Sam to finalize metric dashboards, 4) Marco to prepare customer hold list. Will circle back in 2h for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
